title: Copilot — Daily User Activity Feed
description: Per-user daily Copilot activity log from Loki. Human-readable view of what each developer did with Copilot each day.

options.content:
## Copilot Daily User Activity Feed

This dashboard shows a human-readable daily activity log for each Copilot user sourced from Loki structured logs. Each log line represents one user's complete Copilot activity for one day.

**Data source:** Loki — `{enterprise="sherwin-williams", log_source="copilot_exporter"}` parsed with `| json`

**Data lag:** 2-day lag from GitHub API. Today and yesterday will not appear.

**How to use:** Select a GitHub username from the dropdown to filter to a specific user. Leave on All to see all users. Use the time picker to change the window — maximum 28 days due to Loki query limits.

**Fields available in each log line:** user_login, day, ai_credits_used, prompt_count, loc_added_sum, used_chat, used_agent, used_cli, totals_by_model_feature, totals_by_ide, ai_adoption_phase

panels.title: Active Users (28d)
panels.description: Number of distinct users who appear in Loki logs in the last 28 days. Reflects users with at least one day of Copilot activity.

panels.title: Total Prompts (28d)
panels.description: Total Copilot prompts across all users in the selected window extracted from Loki structured logs.

panels.title: Total LOC Added (28d)
panels.description: Total lines of AI-generated code accepted across all users in the selected window.

panels.title: Total AI Credits Used (28d)
panels.description: Total AI credits consumed across all users in the selected window. 1 credit = $0.01 USD.

panels.title: Top 25 Users by Prompt Count (28d)
panels.description: Most active Copilot users by total prompts submitted in the last 28 days. Use this to identify power users and internal champions.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (user_login) (sum_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | unwrap prompt_count [28d])))

panels.title: Top 25 Users by LOC Added (28d)
panels.description: Users generating the most AI-assisted code by lines accepted in the last 28 days.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (user_login) (sum_over_time({enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | unwrap loc_added_sum [28d])))

panels.title: Daily Activity Log
panels.description: Raw structured daily log records per user. Each line is one user's complete Copilot activity for one day. Expand a line to see all fields including model breakdown, feature breakdown, IDE usage, and credit spend. Filter by username using the dropdown above.

targets.expr: {enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter", user_login=~"$username"} | json | line_format "user={{.user_login}} day={{.day}} prompts={{.prompt_count}} loc={{.loc_added_sum}} credits={{.ai_credits_used}} chat={{.used_chat}} agent={{.used_agent}} cli={{.used_cli}} phase={{.ai_adoption_phase}}"
